releaseNotes: 部署和升级前先用无害的只读检查判断 GitHub、Cloudflare 连接是否仍然有效。
有效连接直接复用；只有官方连接明确要求时才授权一次。
授权后从中断步骤继续并核对已有资源，避免重复创建仓库、Worker、D1 或 MEDIA_KV。

preserve: existing Worker identity and workers.dev hostname
D1 DB binding, resource id, migrations and all stored data
MEDIA_KV binding, resource id and all uploaded media
administrator credentials, sessions and recovery state
access passes, analytics and audit records
